title: HaB
description: Minecraft Server Plugin for custom Join and leave Messages.
body:
# HaB  


HaB is a plugin for your Paper server to customize join and leave Messages.


### **HOW TO EDIT JOIN AND LEAVE MESSAGES?**

Start your server and go into plugins>HaB>Config.yml , there you can edit the join and leave Messages.
To apply changes restart your sever or simply use "/hab reload"
